answer_text: RNZ says it understands so at this stage. On Nov 25 it said it was investigating a cyber breach after unusual activity in one of its systems, and staff lost access to wi-fi and editorial systems. It has not said whether any data was taken.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Is the RNZ breach linked to the Allied Media (Otago Daily Times) attack?
what_would_settle_it: RNZ, Allied Media, the police or the National Cyber Security Centre saying whether the two attacks are connected.

question_text: Was any data taken in the RNZ breach?
what_would_settle_it: RNZ saying what the unusual activity was and whether any staff, audience or other data was accessed or taken.

question_text: Are RNZ's systems back to normal?
what_would_settle_it: An RNZ statement, or reporting with its own sourcing, saying its systems have been restored.

question_text: Who was behind the RNZ cyber breach?
what_would_settle_it: RNZ, the police or the National Cyber Security Centre naming who was responsible.
